result.topic_en: Lecture draft introducing integrals between imaginary limits: a historical note on imaginary quantities (Cardano, Euler, Abel, Jacobi, Gauss), the geometric representation of complex numbers in the plane, and how the concept of quantity is extended from integers to negatives, irrationals and imaginaries.
